name: PIECEMAKERS TECHNOLOGY INC
summary: Piecemakers Technology, Inc., a DRAM design company, provides design service for terabytes/s bandwidth memory. The company offers packaged and unpackaged IC chips for standard and KGD products; and memory chips. It also provides HBLL-RAM, HiBaLL-RAM, PIM-DDR3, Standard DRAM, KGD DRAM, and PSRAM products. The company serves high-performance computing and DRAM applications. Piecemakers Technology, Inc. was founded in 1995 and is headquartered in Hsinchu City, Taiwan.
